basic_details.job_title: RIMS Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Regional Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS) has announced 2 vacancies for Assistant Professor of Dermatology and Assistant Professor of Psychiatry posts under its 2026 recruitment. The pay for both posts is specified as Pay Level - 11, Cell 4 of 7th CPC. Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria can apply online by submitting their applications through the link available on the official RIMS website and paying the application fee of Rs. 1,000 through online mode. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RIMS Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RIMS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Regional Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS), Imphal, Manipur, for filling up Assistant Professor posts in various departments under a regular employment notification.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under RIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment notification offers positions for Assistant Professor of Dermatology and Assistant Professor of Psychiatry departments, offering eligible medical professionals an opportunity to build a rewarding teaching and healthcare career.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Assistant Professor positions across the Dermatology and Psychiatry departments, with 1 post allocated specifically for each discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.D./M.S. in the respective discipline along with 3 years of teaching experience in a recognized medical college as a Resident, Registrar, Demonstrator, or Tutor.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years as on 30th November 2026, with age relaxations provided for government employees and PwD candidates as per existing norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for these posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a competitive salary package as per Pay Level - 11, Cell 4 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC), ensuring robust financial remuneration.

faq.question: Q7. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application window opens on 1 November 2026 and officially closes on 30 November 2026. All interested candidates must submit their forms within this period.

faq.question: Q8. How much is the application fee?
faq.answer: General and unreserved category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1,000/- through online mode, whereas PwD candidates are completely exempted from payment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves the short-listing of eligible candidates followed by a comprehensive personal interview conducted by the competent recruitment authority at RIMS.

faq.question: Q10. How can eligible candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official RIMS website at www.rims.edu.in, filling out the application form, uploading necessary documents, and paying the fee online.
